texts.zh:
尽管表面平淡无奇，[From.GetName]的小行星有着中空的核心，里面贮存着极具工业价值的宝贵晶体——仿佛一个高悬星空的巨大晶球。

通过遵循科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]制定的特殊指示，未来任何采矿平台应该都能小心开采陨石内层的晶体了。
texts.en:
While unremarkable on the surface, the [From.GetName] asteroid has a hollow core lined with industrially valuable crystals - like a gigantic geode hung in the stars.

With special instructions prepared by Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName], any future mining platform should be able to carefully harvest these crystals from the interior of the asteroid.

# 隐秘核心 / Secret Heart

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · DLC：《遥远繁星》Distant Stars（has_distar） · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-12（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：common/anomalies/95_anomaly_categories_distant_stars.txt:221-236; events/distant_stars_events_1.txt:3475 (distar.75)

## 如何开始 How it starts

需要《遥远繁星》。无战略资源的小行星可能生成（5级，权重2）。

Requires Distant Stars. Can spawn on an asteroid without strategic resources (level 5, weight 2).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

distar.75“隐秘核心”：小行星中空，内壁布满有工业价值的晶体，如同悬在星空中的巨大晶洞。小行星获得稀有晶体矿藏；1天后的隐藏 action.941 只发送通用的战略资源发现提示（不属于本故事）。

distar.75 "Secret Heart": the asteroid is hollow and lined with valuable crystals, a giant geode in space. It gains a rare crystals deposit; the hidden action.941 a day later only sends the generic strategic-resource notice (not part of this story).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

唯一结果，无随机分支。

Single outcome; no random branch.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

无文明差异的选项。

No empire-specific option differences.
